verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in error-trend dashboards. The docs say GlitchTip deliberately avoids "dashboard building and metrics hunting" (though that statement is about performance monitoring). The only route to cross-project trend dashboards is an extra tool: the documented Grafana Sentry data source pointed at GlitchTip. Releases can also be recorded through the CLI, which could feed per-release views. Missing for 10: native cross-project/team dashboards, top-regression views, new-issues-per-release reporting, error volume-over-time charts, and evidence of what the Grafana integration actually surfaces.
